Appreciate the CSV — I ran quick scenarios and attached a baseline pricing-model.xlsx showing three profiles:
- Conservative (no quantization, standard batching) -> ~$1,800 / 1M tokens
- Balanced (8-bit quant + optimized batching) -> ~$950 / 1M tokens
- Aggressive (int8 + prefix caching + larger batch targets) -> ~$480 / 1M tokens

Prelim observations:
- For your pilot (50k sessions/mo @ 2.5k tokens = 125M tokens/mo), cost range: $60k/mo (conservative) -> $15k/mo (aggressive).
- To hit $20k/mo inference spend, we need the Balanced profile (~$950/1M) plus a small caching strategy; that lines up with your $20k–$35k band.
- CAC payback target: you mentioned <6 months; with expected ARPU per user and expansion motions, you’d want unit contribution margin of >40% after inference cost. I included a $/feature worksheet that maps incremental MAU -> feature-level gross margin.

Proposed next steps:
1) Wed 22 Jul 10:30am PT — 45m deep-dive with Rishi + Laura to review batching/quantization and run a scenario with your real session mix.
2) Post-call: final unit-econ slide for leadership (single page) and a recommended pricing/commitment band for Dedicated vs Hosted options.

Are you able to share a short list of top 3 example prompts per flow (support, onboarding) so we can model sequence length variance?

—
